descriptions.preferred: 小叶羽团扇品种，因其叶子长的像龙之爪而得名， 叶子有五裂叶和七裂叶，以五叶裂为主，五叶裂为 特征叶，中间三个叶裂长且窄，春叶色为茶绿色， 夏季转为深绿，秋季橙红色。生长速度中等，抗性 佳，超级耐寒，可以到零下 30 度，可全日照，成 年株可达 3 米左右高度。

products.title: Acer sieboldianum 'Shoryu-no-tsume' Claw of the Dragon Full Moon Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer sieboldianum 'Shoryu-no-tsume' Claw of the Dragon - Cold Tolerant Full Moon Japanese Maple Zones 4-9 Acer sieboldianum 'Shoryu-no-tsume' is a brand new cold tolerant full moon maple with a uniquely shaped leaf. 'Shoryu-no-tsume' means "claw of the dragon" which is an excellent and fitting description. The green foliage turns to a brilliant shade of red in the fall. We expect 'Shoryu-no-tsume' to reach 10-12 ft in 15 years. 10 GALLON TREE SHIPS WITHOUT POT DUE TO BOX SIZE CONSTRAINTS
